scope: Corollary 17.1 of the manuscript “Strict convexity and differentiability of the planar exponential first-passage limit shape” (preprints/Strict-convexity-and-differentiability-of-the-planar-exponential-first-passage-limit-shape-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 212 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7cc30ddbfd4419f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 89. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a deterministic unit vector u. There is an event Ωu of probability one on which all the following statements hold. 1. For every x ∈ Z2 there is exactly one infinite geodesic Γu x from x with direction u. For every sequence (zn) directed toward u, including a sequence chosen from the edge configuration, Γ(x, zn) → Γu x locally. 2. For every x, y ∈ Z2, the paths Γu x and Γu y have a common tail. 3. No bigeodesic has an end with direction u. 4. For every x, y ∈ Z2, the limit Bu(x, y) = lim n→∞ T(x, zn) − T(y, zn)  exists and is independent of the choice of sequence directed toward u. Moreover, EBu(0, x) = ∇µ(u) · x, and, for every ε > 0, only finitely many x ∈ Z2 satisfy |Bu(0, x) − ∇µ(u) · x| > ε∥x∥1.
